focus.$description: Tokens for the keyboard focus indicator. The default ring is 2px solid interactive primary, offset 2px from the focused element. Components reference these via `outline: var(--scout-focus-ring-width) solid var(--scout-focus-ring-color); outline-offset: var(--scout-focus-ring-offset);` so theming a focus ring (high-contrast, brand-tinted) becomes a one-token change.

color.$description: Focus ring on invalid form fields.
